column1: # The rules a launch kit must carry, one per line, as the grep -E pattern that proves each is present.
# Read by scripts/kit_reference/check_markers.sh (which tests/test_kit_reference.py drives, and which
# scripts/launch_gpu_box.sh calls at preflight to WARN on a kit that dropped one). Tab-separated:
# surface is where the rule lives: user-data-native rules are the ones the launcher's own preflight
# already refuses or warns about (kept here so the reference kit is checked against the whole list,
# skipped by the launcher's marker pass so nothing is reported twice); user-data rules are checked
# against the rendered user-data; runner rules against the runner named by the user-data's
# RUNNER_TREE_PATH= line when it is in the staged tree. A pattern beginning with ! is FORBIDDEN: the
# rule is broken when it matches. Comment-only lines of the checked file are never matched.
# Every pattern here has been watched to fail: tests/test_kit_reference.py deletes the matching line
# from a rendered copy (or injects the forbidden one) and asserts the checker names this rule.

column4: the max-lifetime dead-man switch, an early unconditional shutdown -h +<minutes> (killswitch layer 1)
an INVOCATION of scripts/ec2_boot_patch.sh out of the verified tree before the job starts
the idle watchdog armed with --minutes (killswitch layer 2)
the watchdog's arm-time verdict published under the run prefix so it outlives the box
the inlined ship guard that verifies the fetched code by content before anything runs it
the agenda-complete marker on the watchdog's own arm line, so the box is torn down within a minute of its last upload
every bootstrap line kept on the box's disk, where the heartbeat and a post-mortem can read it
the staged HEAD sha recorded on the box so every artifact says what code ran (a record, never a gate)
the box records its own instance id (learnt through an IMDSv2 token; the inlined guard fetches one too, so only the record is this template's own) where the runner and its heartbeat key read it
a work-state file seeded before the heartbeat can observe it, so an absent state keeps meaning "died without recording"
the runner named as a path inside the digest-verified tree, so it needs no pin of its own and the launcher can compare it with the reference
the named runner actually invoked out of the verified tree
the box reads its own shutdown behaviour back from the API and halts when it is stop; the launcher's post-launch check from the inside
the heartbeat written to the shared status key the launcher's HeartbeatS3 tag names
the same heartbeat under the run's own prefix, so a reader of one run finds it there
the heartbeat's reward and purity greps read the arm log the stage writes live
forbidden: grepping the run directory's logs/ copy, which exists only after training ends (the v2 and softpen kits read nothing for the whole run)
the agenda runs inside a tmux session, one of the three work signals the idle watchdog reads
an on-demand landing on a priced shape (p5) is held for a human's ratification marker, never auto-taken
what already exists under the run prefix is restored before anything new runs, so a relaunch is a continuation
checkpoints restored newest-first until one is complete, mirroring games.train.missing_checkpoint_files, so the resolver never faces a torn checkpoint with a complete one still in S3
a checkpoint every step, so a reclaim costs one step and the checkpoint interval beats the reclaim cadence
the trainer's own per-save S3 sync pointed under the run prefix
the model pulled into the cache before the hub goes offline
the hub marked offline once the model is cached, so no save spends a network round trip (the test also asserts it comes after the prefetch)
the pace guard's plan figure taken from a parameter of this shape's measured pace
forbidden: a per-shape pace figure baked into the runner, which the next shape inherits unread
every eval cell restores from and syncs to its own S3 prefix on an interval, so a box death loses at most one interval
the closing pass that summarises a cell which died between its last generate call and its summary write, and refuses an unfinished one
forbidden: deleting a partial trace, which throws away paid-for records the cell would have resumed
the work-state file records the exit code and reason, so the heartbeat says why the box stopped
the agenda-complete marker touched as the runner's LAST act, after the final upload has returned (the test also asserts the order)
